messages:
Lena: Quick design review — attached prototype GIF: https://redwood.ai/proto/rewind-gif
Lena: Concern: the rewind gesture (two-finger swipe on desktop) isn't discoverable. Users might expect an explicit 'Rewind' affordance and a visible undo CTA.
Jordan: :eyes: Looking now. General 👍 for keeping timeline compact. But the gesture hint is too subtle.
Sam: Agree. Maybe show a transient hint the first time timeline is opened: 'Tip: press Z to rewind' with a small arrow pointing to the scrubber.
Priya: Accessibility: gestures are invisible to screen readers. We need an explicit button with `aria-label="Rewind to previous snapshot"` and keyboard focus order.
Lena: Good call. Proposal: add a condensed 'Rewind' pill to the left of the scrubber + keyboard shortcut `Z` + tooltip on hover.
Jordan: For copy, change tooltip from 'Rewind' to 'Rewind snapshot (Z)' — keeps it short and scannable.
Sam: Implementation nit: when the pill appears, avoid shifting layout. Use absolute overlay so compact layout unchanged.
Priya: Also add `role="button"` and `aria-keyshortcuts="Z"` for AT users. And expose an announcement: 'Rewind available' when the pill first appears.
Lena: Can we get a quick dev feasibility check? @Sam can you sketch the overlay approach and perf impact?
Sam: Yep, will mock up CSS absolute overlay and add a lazy hydrated tooltip. Estimate: ~2-3 dev days including tests.
deploy-bot: rollout-ui/feature-rewind preview deployed to staging ✅
Jordan: ok, next: undo CTA wording — 'Undo to previous version' vs 'Rewind to snapshot'. Leaning toward 'Rewind to snapshot' to match internal docs.
Priya: 'Snapshot' is more technical; product requested 'version' for customer clarity. Suggest 'Rewind to previous version (Z)'.
Lena: Decision: use 'Rewind to previous version (Z)'. Update copy doc: https://redwood.ai/docs/copy/rebinds
Jordan: I'll add the aria label and tooltip text in the spec PR.
Lena: Thanks everyone — leaving this as action items: Sam: overlay mock + perf estimate, Jordan: PR for copy + aria, Priya: accessibility test cases, Lena: update the design token for pill styles. Back in a week? :calendar:
Sam: 👍
Priya: ✅
Jordan: 👍
Lena: Thanks :sparkles:
